_comment: Industry config for water/fire/mold/biohazard restoration companies.
rsa_guidance: Emphasize 24/7 emergency response, IICRC certification, insurance direct billing, same-day extraction, and preventing secondary damage (mold within 24-48h). Speed and credentials are the top conversion levers.

city.heading: Why Immediate Response Matters
city.intro: Water damage spreads rapidly — mold can begin forming within 24–48 hours. The sooner a certified crew begins extraction and structural drying, the lower your total restoration cost and the less likely you are to face long-term structural damage.
bullets: Within 1 hour: water saturates walls, floors, and personal belongings
Within 24 hours: mold spores begin to activate in wet materials
Within 48 hours: structural materials swell, warp, and may need full replacement
Within 1 week: remediation costs increase 3–5× compared to immediate response

cost.heading: What Does {service} Cost?
cost.intro: Restoration costs depend on the size of the affected area, the materials involved, and how quickly the damage is addressed. The best way to get an accurate number is a free on-site assessment — we never charge for the inspection.
bullets: Affected area: larger areas require more equipment and drying time, increasing cost
Material type: hardwood, drywall, and insulation each require different treatment
Response time: damage addressed within hours costs significantly less than damage left for days
Insurance: most homeowner policies cover sudden water and fire damage — we bill directly
cost.callout: We provide a written upfront estimate before any work begins. No surprises, no hidden fees.

company.heading: Why Choose Us?
company.intro: Not all restoration companies are the same. Here's what sets us apart.
bullets: IICRC Certified: every technician certified by the industry's highest standard
Licensed & Insured: fully licensed contractor with general liability and workers' comp on every job
Local & Family-Owned: not a national franchise — your neighbors call us too
Insurance Direct Billing: we handle the claim process from first call to final settlement

free-estimate.heading: What Happens During a Free Inspection?
free-estimate.intro: Our free assessment is a no-obligation, on-site evaluation by a certified technician. You'll know exactly what you're dealing with and what it will cost before committing to anything.
bullets: We arrive within 60 minutes and assess the full extent of the damage
We identify hidden moisture with thermal imaging and moisture meters
We document everything for your insurance claim (photos, measurements, readings)
We provide a written scope of work and cost estimate on the spot
You decide whether to proceed — zero pressure, zero obligation
free-estimate.callout: The inspection is completely free. If you choose to move forward, we begin work immediately.

insurance.heading: Does Insurance Cover {service}?
insurance.intro: Most standard homeowner and commercial property policies cover sudden and accidental damage. We work directly with all major carriers and help you navigate the claims process from first call to final settlement.
bullets: Direct billing: we invoice your insurer directly — no upfront out-of-pocket cost in most cases
All carriers: State Farm, Allstate, USAA, Farmers, Liberty Mutual, and all others
Documentation: we provide the full photo and moisture report your adjuster needs
Claim assistance: we walk you through the process and answer questions at every step
insurance.callout: Coverage depends on your specific policy and the cause of the damage. We'll clarify during the free inspection.

removal.heading: How {service} Removal Works
removal.intro: Our certified technicians follow a documented removal and restoration process designed to eliminate the damage completely — not just dry the surface.
bullets: Free on-site assessment — moisture mapping, documentation, written estimate
Containment — seal the affected area to prevent cross-contamination
Removal — extract water, remove unsalvageable materials (drywall, flooring, insulation)
Structural drying — industrial dehumidifiers and air movers until readings return to baseline
Treatment — EPA-safe antimicrobial application to prevent mold growth
Clearance testing — air quality verification before sign-off
Restoration — rebuild affected areas to pre-loss condition
